user.title: Connect a PetTec PF 05WD
user.description: The feeder must already be connected to your Wi-Fi, and you need its numeric Xlink access key. This integration does not provision Wi-Fi or recover keys. Setup only reads the device clock.

reauth_confirm.title: Correct the feeder access key
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the numeric Xlink access key for this feeder. Verification only reads its clock.

error.invalid_host: Enter the feeder's IPv4 address, for example 192.168.1.50.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect. Check that the feeder is on Wi-Fi and reachable from Home Assistant.
error.invalid_auth: The access key must be a number from 1 to 999999999 and must match the feeder.
error.unsupported_device: This device does not match the supported PetTec PF 05WD product.
error.unknown: Unable to read the feeder clock. This firmware may use a different protocol.

schedule.title: Edit schedule {slot}
schedule.description: Times use the feeder clock, last read as {clock}. Check that it shows the correct local date and time before enabling a schedule. Submit writes this slot to the feeder and verifies all five slots; other slots are preserved. To disable this slot, clear Enabled.

schedules.title: Stored feeding schedules
schedules.description: Select one of the five schedules read from the feeder. Opening this editor does not change any schedule.

clock.title: Clock settings
clock.description: When enabled, sync once after Home Assistant starts, using its configured local time zone. This setting defaults to off. To sync immediately, use the Sync device clock button. Clock changes affect when stored schedules run. A failed sync is not retried automatically.

data.sync_time_on_startup: Sync device clock on Home Assistant startup

error.invalid_schedule: Choose a time with zero seconds, 1–200 whole grams, and at least one weekday for an enabled schedule.
error.schedule_changed: This slot changed while you were editing it. Cancel and reopen Configure to read its current settings.
error.cannot_save_schedule: Unable to verify the schedule update. Changes may already have been applied. Cancel and reopen Configure to inspect all schedules before trying again.

abort.not_loaded: Load the integration before opening its schedule editor.
abort.cannot_read_schedules: Unable to read all five schedules. No schedules were changed. Check the connection; this firmware may use a different schedule format.
abort.invalid_schedule: Choose a schedule slot from 1 to 5.
